steps.title: Bem-vindo: Family - Volume 16
steps.text: In this A2-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Family". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: My grandparents live in the countryside.
I have two siblings, a brother and a sister.
She's an only child, so she grew up alone.

steps.title: Idiom: Get out of hand
steps.text: It means: "To become uncontrollable.". Say the example sentence out loud:
steps.targetPhrase: The party got out of hand pretty quickly.
